title: Hardware Debloat Ghidra plugin
highlights: Engineered a Ghidra plugin for static control-flow analysis, extracting direct and computed call graphs with overestimation handling and recursive depth tracing.

Designed it to feed DECAF (QEMU-based full-system introspection) so runtime call stacks can be checked against the extracted valid paths to enforce control-flow integrity; the accompanying paper reports minimal runtime overhead on its test cases.

details.heading: Problem
details.body: Controlling hardware access based on valid execution paths helps defend against control-flow hijacking such as ROP, COP and JOP.

details.heading: What the plugin does
details.body: Extracts control flow graphs, identifies direct and computed calls, handles unresolved calls by overestimation and supports recursive depth-controlled tracing.
